claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has configured cost_usd_per_million_tokens backend metadata, provider usage total_tokens, per-call configured cost_estimate records, cost_estimate_status records, runtime configured-cost accounting, LLM budget report configured-cost totals, provider diagnostics summaries, pricing-readiness false fields, configured-pricing aggregate checks, cost-status reason checks, remote default-rate overclaim checks, backend-default count checks, and raw-payload replay overclaim checks. It does not claim live provider pricing, provider default-rate capture, account/model-specific pricing, or raw provider-payload replay.
